correctness.rationale: The exhaustive 2023 normal forms imply exactly three singular idempotent types. Direct evaluation on odd, even and singular input representatives proves all and only the listed commuting pairs, including the special constant-to-identity map. The parity formula follows from involutions independently preserving each rooted kernel fiber, and the labeled exponential formula counts all such decorated rooted blocks. Graph degree/triangle/maximal-clique formulas follow by disjoint rooted labels. A standalone exact checker independently enumerates transformations through n=6 and directly checks every pair of the 571 graph vertices for n=5. Tests are corroboration, not proof of all n.

value.rationale: The exact number of maximal pairwise-commuting retraction families of the most classical finite transformation semigroup is a natural structural invariant. The signed rooted-block EGF gives an all-degree census rather than a fixed example and reveals a diameter-four graph with an explicit cut-vertex and arithmetic page multiplicities. The qualitative band facts in earlier work do not substitute for the quantitative compatibility census.
